claims.assessment: Ports1–3 react more strongly than higher ports; absolute pressures differ by depth. Zone4 depth conflict and unknown rate plotting basis remain on HOLD. No maximum safe-rate curve supplied.

claims.claim: Fluid sampling finds no CO2 migration above baffle
claims.assessment: Reported absence of substantial chemistry change at sampled ports, including July2013 zones4–11. Known CO2 zones2/3 excluded; no detection limits or numeric concentrations. This is not a zero-leakage probability or retained-carbon balance.

Authors report15–20% upper-window NRMS and a lower-window west anomaly. Ground conditions, shot reduction, reference choice and nonunique amplitude response qualify interpretation. No exact processing or saturation inversion reproduced.

Author interpretation using a changing array geometry and3D locations. Raw catalogue, velocity model, uncertainty and completeness missing; perspective plots alone cannot verify every point or absence of migration.

claims.claim: Events reflect pressure-front fluctuations, including shut-ins
claims.assessment: Qualitative integrated association. Event counts, located/detected denominators, time windows, array-name conflict and missing native pressure fronts prevent independent causal or risk validation.

claims.claim: No pre-existing faults supported by3D seismic interpretation
claims.assessment: Seismic interpretation has finite resolution; lack of identified faults is not proof of absence. Strike-slip cluster mechanisms require native events/first-motion/velocity evidence, not a universal fault-safety claim.

claims.claim: Models are robust and predict plume development
claims.assessment: History-matched models are asserted but no complete deck, objective, raw observations, holdout metrics or ensemble is supplied. Calibration and qualitative log agreement do not independently validate future plumes.

claims.claim: Microseismicity is not impacting storage security
claims.assessment: Source conclusion limited to investigated conditions/time. No quantified damage/permeability/leakage bound or future probability supplied. Excluded as a numerical retention or risk parameter.

claims.claim: New IL-ICCS completion above baffle isolates project plumes
claims.assessment: Design interpretation, not demonstrated complete hydraulic isolation. Exact completion/control, baffle continuity and cross-project pressure tests required before interaction or allocation conclusions.
